backtest_protocol.execution_model: SEC non-management proxy-pressure events are read from EDGAR submissions cache recent filings for forms DFAN14A, PX14A6G, PREC14A, and PRRN14A. The signal date is the filing date unless the SEC acceptance timestamp is after 16:00, in which case it is the next trading day. Candidates must show signal-day price absorption before next-open paper entry: non-negative daily return, return minus SPY >= 0.5%, close location >= 0.56, volume ratio >= 0.75, realized vol <= 12%, ret20 excess vs SPY >= -5%, price >= $10, and ADV20 >= $50M. Paper entry is the next available open with entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Focused non-management proxy-pressure forms are a real free SEC submissions event surface with enough three-window coverage and are distinct from rejected 13D/13G ownership entries, 13F/Form144 delayed ownership, and generic 8-K/text labels. The likely disconfirmer is governance-event noise or the event being priced before next-open paper entry.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing SEC submissions cache, missing CIK mapping, missing proxy pressure event rows, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT SEC DFAN14A/PX14A6G/PREC14A/PRRN14A events, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
